axi_crossbar_addr.summary: AXI crossbar address decoder: a two-state FSM decodes the slave address into master select/region or decode error, enforcing outstanding-transaction and per-ID thread limits tracked by counters.

blocks.name: Decode controller
blocks.description: IDLE/DECODE FSM issuing address, write command and reply command handshakes.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/DECODE controller: decodes address, issues outputs, waits for handshakes before aready.

anchors.name: s_axi_avalid
anchors.why: Address valid starting a decode in IDLE.

anchors.name: s_axi_aready
anchors.why: Registered address ready pulsed after all outputs handshake.

anchors.name: m_axi_avalid
anchors.why: Decoded address valid toward selected master.

anchors.name: m_axi_aready
anchors.why: Master address ready clearing address valid.

anchors.name: m_wc_valid
anchors.why: Write command valid carrying select and decerr when WC_OUTPUT.

anchors.name: m_rc_valid
anchors.why: Reply command valid issued on decode error.

blocks.name: Address decoder
blocks.description: Compares address/prot to master regions, yields select, region and decerr.

anchors.name: s_axi_aaddr
anchors.why: Slave address compared against master base addresses to select destination.

anchors.name: m_select
anchors.why: Decoded destination master index steering the crossbar.

anchors.name: m_axi_aregion
anchors.why: Decoded region index within selected master.

anchors.name: match
anchors.why: Address matched a permitted master region; chooses issue versus decode error.

anchors.name: m_decerr_reg
anchors.why: Decode error flag on no-match, sent to write and reply command outputs.

blocks.name: Transaction tracking
blocks.description: Global outstanding counter and per-ID thread table enforcing accept and ordering limits.

anchors.name: trans_count_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding transaction count, incremented on start, decremented on completion.

anchors.name: trans_limit
anchors.why: Outstanding limit reached; blocks new decode issue.

anchors.name: trans_start
anchors.why: Transaction issue pulse updating counters and thread table.

anchors.name: thread_id_reg
anchors.why: Per-thread table of active IDs with destination, preserving ID ordering.

anchors.name: thread_count_reg
anchors.why: Per-thread outstanding count; nonzero marks thread active.

anchors.name: thread_match
anchors.why: Incoming ID matches an active thread.

anchors.name: thread_match_dest
anchors.why: Matching thread targets same master/region, allowing issue.

anchors.name: s_cpl_valid
anchors.why: Completion strobe decrementing transaction and thread counters.

anchors.name: stage_valid
anchors.why: memory array

anchors.name: stage_enc
anchors.why: memory array

arbiter.summary: Parameterized arbiter: two priority encoders (plain and round-robin-masked) pick a requester, registered into one-hot grant, encoded index and valid, with optional blocking hold.

blocks.name: Grant controller
blocks.description: Next-grant logic and grant registers selecting one requester per cycle.

anchors.name: grant_reg
anchors.why: Registered one-hot grant vector chosen from priority-encoded requests; drives grant port.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Grant valid output from grant_valid_reg; used for blocking hold check.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Binary index of the granted port, from grant_encoded_reg.

anchors.name: request_valid
anchors.why: Any-request flag from priority encoder; enables issuing a new grant.

anchors.name: request_index
anchors.why: Encoded index of highest-priority request, loaded into grant_encoded_next.

blocks.name: Priority encoders
blocks.description: Plain and round-robin-masked priority encoders over requests.

anchors.name: masked_request_valid
anchors.why: Masked-request present flag choosing masked grant in round-robin mode.

anchors.name: mask_reg
anchors.why: Round-robin priority mask applied to requests; inactive with default ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN=0.

ungrouped_anchors.name: request
ungrouped_anchors.why: Per-port request vector fed to both priority encoders.

ungrouped_anchors.name: acknowledge
ungrouped_anchors.why: Per-port acknowledge releasing a held grant in blocking-ack mode.

axi_register_wr.summary: AXI4 write-path register slice: AW, W and B channels each pass through a parameterized bypass, simple register, or skid buffer with valid/ready handshakes.

blocks.name: aw_channel_register
blocks.description: Simple register slice on write address channel, inserts bubble cycles.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave write address captured into AW channel register toward master.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave AW valid; loads AW register when ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: Slave AW ready from AW register occupancy.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Registered write address forwarded on master AW channel.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Master AW valid from AW register valid flag.

blocks.name: w_channel_skid_buffer
blocks.description: Skid buffer with output and temp registers on write data channel.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Slave write data buffered through W skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave W valid; steers W skid buffer storage into output or temp.

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Slave W ready from skid buffer temp/output occupancy.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Registered write data driven on master W channel.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Master W valid from W output register.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: Master W ready; drains W output register and temp register.

blocks.name: b_channel_register
blocks.description: Simple register slice on write response channel back to slave.

anchors.name: genblk3.s_axi_bvalid_reg
anchors.why: B channel register valid flag driving slave bvalid.

anchors.name: genblk3.m_axi_bready_reg
anchors.why: Registered master bready; enables capture of B response into register.

anchors.name: genblk3.s_axi_bresp_reg
anchors.why: Registered B response forwarded to slave bresp.

anchors.name: genblk3.store_axi_b_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing master B id/resp/user into B registers.

anchors.name: s_axi_bready
anchors.why: Slave bready clears B register valid.

axi_crossbar_wr.summary: AXI4 write crossbar: per-slave address decoders and W-routing select masters, per-master round-robin arbiters mux AW/W channels with issue limits, and per-slave arbiters return B responses routed by ID, all wrapped by register slices.

blocks.name: Slave register slices and ports
blocks.description: Per-slave AW/W/B register slices feeding internal crossbar signals.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave-port write address valid into input register slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave-port write address decoded to select target master.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave-port write data valid.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Slave-port write data routed to selected master.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid returned to each slave port.

blocks.name: Slave address decode
blocks.description: Per-slave decoder selecting target master with admission control and completions.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].a_select
anchors.why: Decoded target master steering address valid and ready per slave.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_wc_valid
anchors.why: Write command from decoder loading W routing select.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_rc_valid
anchors.why: Decode-error response command triggering local error response.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].s_cpl_valid
anchors.why: Completion notifying decoder to release outstanding transaction.

blocks.name: Slave W routing
blocks.description: Routes each slave W burst to decoded master or drops on decode error.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].w_select_reg
anchors.why: Slave-side W destination master select for current burst.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].w_select_valid_reg
anchors.why: W routing active until wlast; blocks new write commands.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].w_drop_reg
anchors.why: Drops write data for decode-error bursts while acking.

blocks.name: Slave B response arbiter
blocks.description: Round-robin selects master or decerr response onto each slave B channel.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].b_grant
anchors.why: One-hot B response grant among masters and decerr.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].b_grant_encoded
anchors.why: Selects granted master response onto slave B channel.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_axi_bid_mux
anchors.why: Muxed response ID to slave register and completion.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].decerr_m_axi_bvalid_reg
anchors.why: Local DECERR write response request into B arbiter.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].decerr_m_axi_bid_reg
anchors.why: Holds ID for decode-error response.

blocks.name: Master AW arbiter
blocks.description: Per-master round-robin arbitration and AW field mux from slaves.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_grant
anchors.why: Round-robin AW grant among slaves per master.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_grant_encoded
anchors.why: Selects granted slave AW fields and loads W select.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_request
anchors.why: Per-slave AW requests gated by issue limit and W busy.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].s_axi_awaddr_mux
anchors.why: Muxed AW address to master register slice.

blocks.name: Master W mux
blocks.description: Forwards granted slave W burst to master until wlast.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].w_select_reg
anchors.why: Master-side W source slave select for current burst.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].w_select_valid_reg
anchors.why: W burst in progress until wlast; gates W valid/ready.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].w_select_new_reg
anchors.why: Ensures W select loads once per new AW grant.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].s_axi_wdata_mux
anchors.why: Muxed write data to master register slice.

blocks.name: Master issue limiter
blocks.description: Counts outstanding writes per master, blocks arbitration at limit.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].trans_count_reg
anchors.why: In-flight write transactions per master, limits issue.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].trans_limit
anchors.why: Blocks AW requests when M_ISSUE reached.

blocks.name: Master ports and response routing
blocks.description: Master register slices; B responses steered to slave by ID bits.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Master-port write address valid from output register slice.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Master-port write address of granted slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Master-port write data of selected slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_bid
anchors.why: Response ID whose upper bits identify originating slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Master-port write response valid.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].b_select
anchors.why: Response destination slave from BID upper bits.
